digest.component_or_area: configuration and credential lifecycle enforcement (RP-04 ownership gate)
propositions: An AST-based ownership gate must deterministically reject direct and aliased environment variable access, backend property reloads, and configurable adapter defaults that bypass approved composition seam owners.

Configuration and credential names declared in registries must have exactly one owning seam; the ownership enforcement must fail on unowned new names, broad-path globs, and must shrink legacy migration exceptions to empty before contract phase.

Generated documentation (config.md, security.md) must be byte-current with schema and ownership registries and cover lifecycle, precedence, restart, observability, subprocess, and behavior-delta topics; both ownership and field-consumption gates must execute in make lint and CI.

Legacy facades, per-job SSM paths, ambient reloads, and migration exceptions must be removed only after focused suites and bounded live canaries (provider, AWS review-bot, reconciler) pass with redacted evidence and no credential leakage.
